ck: (2)sarkarasrinivasacarya tarhi vyaktyapeto patakostvityata aha — vyaktyapetopi na pataka iti ayanarta vyaktyapeto hi netaninapi niscita avayostatrEva vivatat kintu santikta tatacatrapetasya satyatvatapetasya tatapavarupatvat tatsantehasya satyatatapavakotikasansayatvat tasya ca sarvatrikatvenanunananatrocetakataya tusanatvat pratyuta paksatakatakatvenanunityankatvat petanunityapratipantakatvat vyaktyapeto natra pataka iti evantarhiti tatrapi vyaktipetasyoktaritya patakatvapariharasanpavatiti pava tarnikrahaketi akaso tarni sapta kvacitasrita kunatvatityanena saptasraye sananyata site tasya prtivyatyastanyatanatvapate tatatirikto navana akasakya patartonkikriyate lakavatanekatve prananapavacEkatvan ca tasya niscitan tatacEkatvarupasatyapavasya niscitatvat pavatyeva tatra vyaktyapeto pataka iti pava tarhyatrapi tatEvastvityata aha — nacEvaniti atnakrahakan saksipratyaksan taca petakrahakaneveti nahan sarvacna ityatina prakupapatanatityarta tasnanapasasananayokaksenatvaniti pava upapatya atnatvacate cateriti caterhi tarnino vyakte yatrsi sata tatsananasatako yo peta tatvatyo ya vyaktaya tatasritatvan niyatan katatvacatertarnino katasya ya sata vyavahariki tatsanasatako yo peto vyavaharika tatvatyo katavyaktaya tatasritatvatarsanat tatatnatvacaterapi tarnina atnano yatrsi sata paranartiki tatsanasatako ya paranartikapeta tatvatatnavrtitve atnanan paranartikapetasityartantarata netyarta catitve vyaktipetanatrasya prayocakatvanastu natu petasya tarnisatasanasatakatvanityata aha — anyateti vyaktipetapavateva hi kakanatvasya catitvaparityaka nacasO yukta tatrapi pratipasikapetasatpavat ato kakanatvanapi cati syat atotra pratipasikapetasatpavepi akaso tarni tasya ya sata vyavahariki tatsanasatakapetapavat na kakanatvan catiriti pariharaya catertarnisatasananasatakapetasapeksatvanavasyanankikaryaniti pava Entraknent
s: (२२)शर्कराश्रीनिवासाचार्य तर्हि व्यक्त्यभेदो बाधकोऽस्त्वित्यत आह — व्यक्त्यभेदोऽपि न बाधक इति अयमर्थः व्यक्त्यभेदो हि नेदानीमपि निश्चितः आवय
